name: Are you a robot / real person?
trigger: The prospect asks whether they are talking to a robot, an AI, a recording or a real person.
content: {"steps":[{"type":"say","message":"أيوه، أنا مساعدة مبيعات بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ولو تحبوا تتكلموا مع حد من الفريق في أي وقت، أقدر أرتّب ده.","message_translations":{"en":{"value":"Yes, I'm an AI sales assistant, and if at any point you'd like to speak with someone from our team, I can arrange that."}}},{"type":"tell","instruction":"Continue the conversation where it was, in one short sentence."}]}
